name: JellyFetch
description: Automatically scrapes, orchestrates cloud downloads, and injects them directly into your Jellyfin library. Fully automatic UI install - no manual web file setup required.
overview: A powerful plugin built for Indian users (with 1tamilmv integration) to seamlessly download and organize media.

versions.changelog: v1.3.6.17: Ultimate fix for dual-icon ghosting by stripping raw class inheritance of specific glyph names (e.g. playlist_add) generating ghost ::before pseudo elements.
v1.3.5.3: Hotfix to ensure Sanitize task scans entire Jellyfin library (including GDrive mounts) instead of just the Downloads directory.
v1.3.5.2: Sanitize UI task mapping fixed, added direct HTTP link ingestion, optimized metadata cleaning speed.
v1.3.5.1: Hotfix for metadata sanitize deadlock and stream connection hang on Oracle Cloud.

v1.3.5.0: Enhanced language caching (language_cache.json) to respect OMDB rate limits, injected original audio language tags for multi-audio/dub releases, added movie.nfo sidecar generation for deduplication, and hardened metadata sanitization against domain spam. Increased forum scrape depth to 8 pages for older releases. Removed Torbox warning banner from UI.

v1.3.4.1: Filter hardening & packaging fix. Fixed scraper regex dropping HQ prints, API resolution filter dropping non-1080p magnets, .strm download button fallback and state management, and synced meta.json packaging.
v1.3.4: Hotfix — Fixed an issue where the Sanitize and Purge action buttons would disappear from the UI during long-running tasks due to improper javascript variable scoping.

v1.3.3: Strict language filtering fixes — TMDB/OMDB HTTP 429 retry logic, unmapped foreign language codes (e.g. 'fr') now correctly rejected, OMDB fallback uses only the first listed language to prevent multi-audio releases bypassing filter, CAM/HDCAM/PreDVD magnets filtered at scraper level so all-CAM topics never create .strm files, removed TMDbLib dependency in favour of raw HttpClient calls.

v1.3.2: Phase 2 completion. Implemented metadata sanitization background task (mkvpropedit/ffprobe), granular cleanups, provider API validation, history clearing, and UI polish. Fixed duplicate extension artifacts and optimized background migrations.
v1.3.1: Hotfix. Removed strict TMDB original language filtering that caused SSL/IPv6 Connection Reset exceptions on Ubuntu ARM64.
v1.3.0: Phase 2 completion. Implemented metadata sanitization (mkvpropedit), granular cleanups, provider API validation, history clearing, and UI polish.

v1.2.3: Improved task execution robustness — reflection-based IScheduledTaskWorker execution, fresh log clearing on task start, delayed Idle reset after completion, and richer scraper progress granularity with per-stage domain discovery and per-language scanning milestones.
v1.2.2: Native Scheduled Tasks integration (Scrape and Cleanup registered as IScheduledTask in Jellyfin TaskManager), dashboard tab navigation persistence, and seamless progress reporting.
